# Diego Crisafulli

> Backend and full-stack software developer in Montreal, Canada. Five
> internships across three years at McKesson, CAE and Presagis, building
> AI agents, data pipelines and simulation systems in Python, C++ and .NET.
> Graduating from Concordia University in September 2026.

## About

Currently at McKesson building a retrieval-augmented (RAG) AI agent that
ingests recorded calls into transcripts, keyframes and summaries, and makes
the corpus semantically searchable. Previously three internships at CAE in
performance-sensitive C++ — LiDAR and infrared simulation, sensor-stream
pipelines, developer tooling — and two at Presagis on an NVIDIA Omniverse
digital-twin pipeline.
